title: Resolution and Lean 4 Formal Verification of Conjecture 7.7 on the Second-Order Variance of Multinomial Discrete Total Variation
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 100% Lean 4 kernel-verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue
core_result: Proves Conjecture 7.7 (conj:atriangle) of Banic & Elezovic (arXiv:2610.17046v1, confirmed open in arXiv:2611.14735v1) via an exact 2D-to-1D combinatorial telescoping reduction, sharp non-asymptotic Stirling bounds, and cubic odd-Gaussian Euler-Maclaurin summation, establishing b_0 = 32*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), b_1 = b_2 = -22*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), d_0 = -4*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), a_triangle = 1/32 - 4*sqrt(3)/243, and gamma_2 = -1/(32*pi) - 8*sqrt(3)/(243*pi), rendering linear gamma(n) and cyclic gamma_c(n) unconditional for n >= 5.
verification_boundary: Entire proof of Conjecture 7.7, exact nested-sum fidelity check (hAdj_eq_nested_sum), and unconditional gamma(n) & gamma_c(n) closed forms are 100% kernel-checked in Lean 4 (4,960 lines, 0 sorry, standard axioms only), independently verified in exact rational arithmetic (L=3..45, 0/1 error) and 80-digit Richardson extrapolation (< 3e-55 error).
